lines.zh: : 嗯，既然那只可能意味着一件事，我就直问了。你介意吗？

lines.en: : So that’s...Sana, Yumi, and Nodoka who are “aware” now. What about Noriko? And did anyone try talking to Tsuneyo or did we just leave her out after the public nudity thing?

lines.en: : So...what’s the next step? Buckle up and wait to see if the world ends?

lines.en: As I sit on my stool, contemplating what will or won’t change after tonight, all I can really do is hope that there isn’t another apocalypse on the horizon. But if there {i}is{/i} one, at least I’m already naked.
lines.zh: 我坐在小板凳上，琢磨今晚之后什么会变、什么不会变，而我能做的只有祈祷地平线上不会再有另一场末日。但如果{i}真{/i}有的话，至少我已经光着了。

lines.en: I don’t think there will be, though. At least not tonight. And I may have just jinxed myself by admitting that, but I’m going to stick to my guns here as I’m actually...feeling a little hopeful for a change.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得不会。至少今晚不会。虽然承认这一点可能已经让我立了个flag，但我打算坚持自己的判断，因为我其实……难得感到了一丝希望。

lines.en: In just a few hours, the amount of people aware of this world has doubled. Maybe the cracks are...finally starting to get a little too large to be patched up just once every few months?
lines.zh: 短短几个小时里，知道这个世界真相的人数翻了一倍。也许那些裂缝……终于开始大到光靠每隔几个月修补一次已经不够了？

lines.en: At this rate, it’s only a matter of time until everyone knows, but...
lines.zh: 照这个速度，所有人都知道只是时间问题，可是……

lines.en: What exactly happens when {i}that{/i} happens?

lines.en: A class full of teenagers isn’t going to be able to iron out any wrinkles in time, even {i}if{/i} there are girls like Nodoka and Makoto in it.

lines.en: Maybe we’re all just doomed to keep doing this forever? But...maybe everyone knowing would give us everything we {i}want?{/i}
lines.zh: 也许我们注定要永远这么循环下去？可是……也许所有人都知道了，反而能给我们{i}想要{/i}的一切？

lines.en: Maybe we already {i}have{/i} everything we want? And it’s just that looming worry that someone could be taken from us at any moment that makes it so-
lines.zh: 也许我们已经{i}拥有{/i}想要的一切了？只是那份随时可能失去某人的隐忧，让一切变得——

lines.en: Soon enough, every one of them is asleep. Even Ayane. And the last thing she wrote is this:
